name: @finapp/m29-ai-governance
description: M29 — AI Governance & Release (Stage 5, GOVERNED, mvp:false): the enterprise oversight layer for the AI lifecycle. It governs AI USE CASES, POLICIES and the RELEASE of M24 assets (model/prompt/provider/policy/use-case versions) with human-approved release gates, evaluation evidence, controlled exceptions/waivers, and suspension/withdrawal decisions. THE LOAD-BEARING RULE: AI NEVER APPROVES ITS OWN RELEASE — final release approval requires a HUMAN who is not the proposer (maker != checker / proposer != approver), a passing evaluation and a policy check, enforced in pure logic, the service layer and DB CHECKs. It records governed DECISIONS + EVIDENCE and EMITS the ai.governance_lifecycle event (owned/declared by M24) into the ONE m06 outbox as an authorized emitter — it does NOT declare a second family, own a second outbox, or duplicate the M24 provider/model/request/output foundation. It references M24 assets by OPAQUE id only (reads no m24/business table, calls no provider, stores no credential/secret, holds no prompt/output content). It performs NO domain action, NO deployment/runtime control and NO REST API (internal governed library, api_prefixes []). Confidence/accuracy are integer basis points; no float; no secret column. No production provider, no network, no HTTP client.
